# Case In Paint: Apache config for Bluehost ({{ "staging, served from /staging/" if staging else "production, served from the site root" }})
# Generated by build.py. Edit templates/htaccess.txt, not this file.

Options -Indexes
DirectoryIndex index.html index.php
ErrorDocument 404 {{ base }}404.html
AddType video/mp4 .mp4
AddType image/webp .webp

<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
  RewriteEngine On
  RewriteBase {{ base }}
{% if not staging %}

  # Always use HTTPS
  RewriteCond %{HTTPS} !=on
  RewriteCond %{HTTP:X-Forwarded-Proto} !https
  RewriteRule ^ https://%{HTTP_HOST}%{REQUEST_URI} [L,R=301]
{% endif %}

  # Old WordPress and draft URLs -> new pages
  RewriteRule ^cosplay/?$ {{ base }}props-display/ [R={{ 302 if staging else 301 }},L]
  RewriteRule ^(gallery|process|commissions|about)\.html$ {{ base }}$1/ [R={{ 302 if staging else 301 }},L]
  RewriteRule ^pricing(\.html)?/?$ {{ base }}commissions/ [R={{ 302 if staging else 301 }},L]
  RewriteRule ^(feed|comments/feed|wp-sitemap\.xml)/?$ {{ base }} [R={{ 302 if staging else 301 }},L]
</IfModule>

<IfModule mod_headers.c>
{% if staging %}
  # Keep the preview out of search engines
  Header set X-Robots-Tag "noindex, nofollow"
{% endif %}
  Header always set X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff"
  Header always set Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
  Header always set X-Frame-Options "SAMEORIGIN"
</IfModule>

<IfModule mod_deflate.c>
  AddOutputFilterByType DEFLATE text/html text/css application/javascript application/json image/svg+xml text/xml application/xml text/plain
</IfModule>

<IfModule mod_expires.c>
  ExpiresActive On
  ExpiresDefault "access plus 1 hour"
  ExpiresByType text/html "access plus 0 seconds"
  ExpiresByType text/css "access plus 1 year"
  ExpiresByType application/javascript "access plus 1 year"
  ExpiresByType image/webp "access plus 1 month"
  ExpiresByType image/jpeg "access plus 1 month"
  ExpiresByType image/png "access plus 1 month"
  ExpiresByType image/x-icon "access plus 1 month"
  ExpiresByType video/mp4 "access plus 1 month"
</IfModule>
